subject: Reference Briefing: PicoHealth — availability & agenda
messages:
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
To: Elena Ramos <elena@picohealth.com>, Jared Cole <jared.cole@picohealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-05T08:12:00-07:00
Subject: Reference Briefing: PicoHealth — availability & agenda

Hi Elena + Jared,

Thanks again for agreeing to explore a short customer reference with us — we really appreciate your time. We’d like to run a 30-minute discovery-style briefing to capture the story behind how PicoHealth uses Redwood Inference (high-level goals, what changed after going live, and one or two concrete metrics if you’re comfortable sharing).

Proposed objectives (attached agenda):
- 5m quick intros and context
- 10m goals & rollout story (product/ops)
- 10m technical/implementation notes (KV caching, batching, quant profiles)
- 5m outcomes & next steps + permissions for recording/quote approval

We often record these short sessions to make note-taking easier; happy to restrict recording to audio only or to skip recording entirely if you prefer. I’ve attached a draft agenda and a standard recording/release form for your legal team to glance at.

Can you confirm:
1) A 30-minute slot next week that works for the right stakeholders (we typically request a PM and one engineering/ops person)
2) Whether you’re okay with audio recording and our standard release language, or any constraints we should follow

If it’s easier, here’s a Calendly link with our availability: https://calendly.com/redwood/pico-reference-30m.

Thanks — I’ll loop in Marcus from our infra team if you want to cover any deeper technical details.

Best,
Lauren Bishop
Sr. Customer Marketing Manager
Redwood Inference
attachments: pico_health_briefing_agenda.docx, recording_release_form.pdf

From: Elena Ramos <elena@picohealth.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Jared Cole <jared.cole@picohealth.com>
Date: 2027-04-05T13:40:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Reference Briefing: PicoHealth — availability & agenda

Hi Lauren — thanks for the clear outline. We’re open to participating; a 30-minute call next week should work. Couple of notes from our side:

- Please include our Legal reviewer on the thread (I’ll add them after we lock time) — they’ll want to confirm the release language.
- We prefer audio-only recording; transcripts that capture verbatim customer data need to be avoided.
- We would like the option to redact any customer names or sensitive metric details before anything is published.

Availability: Tue 4/13 10:00–11:30 PT, Wed 4/14 09:00–12:00 PT, or Fri 4/16 13:00–15:00 PT.

If those don’t work for you, suggest times and we’ll try to accommodate. I’ll also loop in our Engineering lead (Jared — cc’d) once we pick a slot.

Best,
Elena Ramos
Director of Product Operations
PicoHealth

Subject: PicoHealth reference briefing — confirmed (Tue 4/13, 10:00 PT)

Hi all — calendar invite sent for Tue, Apr 13 at 10:00–10:30 PT (Zoom link in invite). Please see the finalized agenda below and a short checklist so we’re all aligned before the call.

Finalized agenda (30m):
- 0–5m: Introductions and context (Lauren + Pico stakeholders)
- 5–15m: Business goals & rollout story (Elena + product/ops)
- 15–25m: Implementation highlights (Marcus + infra notes)
- 25–30m: Outcomes, permissions & next steps (Lauren)

Pre-call checklist:
- Elena: confirm if Legal will require any edits to the attached recording_release_form.pdf (we can accept redaction-only constraint)
- Pico: identify PM and one engineering/ops attendee for the session (Jared confirmed)
- Redwood: we will record audio only; we will send a draft quote to Pico for approval prior to publication

Attachments: recording_release_form.pdf (we don’t require signatures for the briefing — a reply confirming consent is sufficient — but if Legal prefers a signed copy we’re happy to accept it).

If you prefer we can anonymize the case study (remove company name) — just let us know. Looking forward to the conversation.

–Marissa Cole
Customer Marketing Coordinator
Redwood Inference
